forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link
forgotPassword.sentBody: If {email} has an account, we've sent a password reset link. The link expires in 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter a new password for your account
resetPassword.newPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers
resetPassword.invalidSubtitle: The reset code is missing. Please request a new link.
resetPassword.doneSubtitle: You can now sign in with your new password.

modal.loginSub: Sign in to book vehicles and manage your trips.
modal.registerSub: Create an account to book faster and follow your trips.

login.identifierPlaceholder: Enter your email or phone number

register.passwordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers

registered.title: Account created
registered.body: You can now search and book vehicles, update your profile, or register as a host.
registered.ownerNote: Only register a shop if you want to rent vehicles out — your current account is enough to book.

setPassword.title: Set a password
setPassword.body: Set a password to sign in faster next time. You can still use OTP if you skip this.
setPassword.newPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers

socialError.notConfigured: Social sign-in is not configured. Please contact support.
socialError.popupClosed: You closed the sign-in window before it finished.
socialError.cancelled: An earlier sign-in request replaced this one. Please try again.
socialError.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
socialError.unauthorizedDomain: This domain is not allowed in Firebase Authentication.
socialError.operationNotAllowed: This sign-in method is not enabled in Firebase.
socialError.accountExists: This email is already registered with a different method. Please use that method.
socialError.network: Could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
socialError.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
socialError.userDisabled: This sign-in account has been disabled.
socialError.generic: Could not sign in with {provider}. Please try again.
